message.content: Set up unit tests for the UserProfile component using Vitest

content.thinking: Need to set up Vitest with React Testing Library for component testing. Should cover the main functionality and edge cases.

message.content: How do I run the tests?

content.text:
Run tests with these commands:

```bash
# Run all tests
npm test

# Run in watch mode
npm run test:watch

# Run with coverage
npm run test:coverage
```

Make sure your `package.json` has the test scripts configured:

```json
{
  "scripts": {
    "test": "vitest run",
    "test:watch": "vitest",
    "test:coverage": "vitest run --coverage"
  }
}
```
